if object_id('tempdb..#tempprovjera1') is not null drop table #tempprovjera1
select t.id as trgovinaid, o.datumobrade into #tempprovjera1 from totalgenmultiselecttemp t inner join trgovina tr with(nolock) on t.id=tr.trgovinaid inner join (select trgovinaid,max(datumobrade) as datumobrade from mpobrada group by trgovinaid) o on t.id=o.trgovinaid where t.operateriid=@@operateriid

drop table #tempprovjera1

if object_id('tempdb..#tempprovjera2') is not null drop table #tempprovjera2
select t.id as trgovinaid, o.datumobrade into #tempprovjera2 from totalgenmultiselecttemp t inner join (select trgovinaid,max(datumobrade) as datumobrade from mpobrada group by trgovinaid) o on t.id=o.trgovinaid where t.operateriid=@@operateriid
declare @poruka varchar(200), @trgovinaopis varchar(50)
if (select count(*) from mpobrada mp inner join #tempprovjera2 t on mp.trgovinaid=t.trgovinaid and mp.DatumObrade=t.datumobrade where mp.datumobrade <= (select datumknjizenja from knttem where knttemid in (select max(mattemid) from maloprodajagla where trgovinaid=mp.trgovinaid and mattemid in (select knttemid from knttem))))>0 begin
set @trgovinaopis = (select oznaka +' ' +opis from trgovina where Trgovinaid in (select top 1 mp.Trgovinaid from mpobrada mp inner join #tempprovjera2 t on mp.trgovinaid=t.trgovinaid and mp.DatumObrade=t.datumobrade where mp.datumobrade <= (select datumknjizenja from knttem where knttemid in (select max(mattemid) from maloprodajagla where trgovinaid=mp.trgovinaid and mattemid in (select knttemid from knttem)))))
set @poruka = 'Odabrano razdoblje za zaključak i knjiženje za trgovinu '+@trgovinaopis+' je već proknjiženo! Ne može se ponovno knjižiti isti period !' exec spRaiserror 69001, @poruka return end
if (select count(*) from mpobrada mp inner join #tempprovjera2 t on mp.trgovinaid=t.trgovinaid and mp.DatumObrade=t.datumobrade where mp.status<2)>0 begin
set @trgovinaopis = (select oznaka +' ' +opis from trgovina where Trgovinaid in (select top 1 mp.Trgovinaid from mpobrada mp inner join #tempprovjera2 t on mp.trgovinaid=t.trgovinaid and mp.DatumObrade=t.datumobrade where mp.status<2))
set @poruka = 'Za odabrano razdoblje za zaključak i knjiženje za trgovinu '+@trgovinaopis+' nije odrađena analiza kartica! Prvo se mora odraditi analiza kartica !' exec spRaiserror 69001, @poruka return end
drop table #tempprovjera2

UPDATE_NC.NAME: UPDATE_NC
UPDATE_NC.CAPTION: Obnova nabavnih cijena po maloprodajnim dokumentima ?
UPDATE_NC.ONLOAD: select opis as trgovina from trgovina where trgovinaid = @@id
UPDATE_NC.ONLOADEDprastaro:
declare @vrstadokid int, @orgshemaid int, @datum datetime, @datumobrade datetime
set @orgshemaid = (select orgshemaid from trgovina where trgovinaid = @@id)
set @vrstadokid = ( select vrstadokid From vrstadok v inner join vrstaprom vp on v.vrstapromid = vp.vrstapromid and sifra = '52' where v.opis like '%tem%mat%mp%')
--set @datum = cast(year(getdate()) as char(4))+'0101'--ksenija 20110914 zakomentirala set @datum = cast((year(getdate())-1) as char(4))+'1231'--ksenija 20110914 postavila na 31.12.prethodne godine da bi u obnovu ušlo i PS u MP ove godine
set @datumobrade = (select coalesce(max(datumknjizenja),@datum) from knttem k with (nolock) inner join kntpromet kp with (nolock) on k.knttemid = kp.knttemid where k.vrstadokid = @vrstadokid and kp.orgshemaid = @orgshemaid)
select @datumobrade as datumobrade
UPDATE_NC.ONLOADEDstaro: select datumknjizenja+1 as datumobrade from knttem where knttemid in (select max(mattemid) from maloprodajagla where trgovinaid=@@id and mattemid in (select knttemid from knttem))
UPDATE_NC.ONLOADED: select coalesce((select max(datumknjizenja)+1 from knttem where knttemid in (select mattemid from maloprodajagla where trgovinaid=@@id and mattemid in (select knttemid from knttem))), (select min(datumdok)-1 as datumobrade from maloprodajagla where trgovinaid=@@id and status=2)) as datumobrade

declare @vrstadokid int, @orgshemaid int, @datum datetime, @datumobrade datetime
set @orgshemaid = (select orgshemaid from trgovina where trgovinaid = @@id)
set @vrstadokid = ( select vrstadokid From vrstadok v inner join vrstaprom vp on v.vrstapromid = vp.vrstapromid and sifra = '52' where v.opis like '%tem%mat%mp%')
--set @datum = cast(year(getdate()) as char(4))+'0101'--ksenija 20110914 zakomentirala set @datum = cast((year(getdate())-1) as char(4))+'1231'--ksenija 20110914 postavila na 31.12.prethodne godine da bi u obnovu ušlo i PS u MP ove godine
set @datumobrade = (select coalesce(max(datumknjizenja),@datum) from knttem k with (nolock) inner join kntpromet kp with (nolock) on k.knttemid = kp.knttemid where k.vrstadokid = @vrstadokid and kp.orgshemaid = @orgshemaid)
update mpobrada set datumknjizenja=null where trgovinaid = @@id and datumknjizenja is not null and datumobrade > @datumobrade
PROKNJIZI.ONLOAD: declare @datumobrade datetime set @datumobrade = (select max(datumknjizenja) from knttem where knttemid in (select mattemid from maloprodajagla where trgovinaid=@@id and mattemid in (select knttemid from knttem))) update mpobrada set datumknjizenja=null where trgovinaid = @@id and datumknjizenja is not null and datumobrade > @datumobrade
